title: Hordes.io
description: Free browser MMORPG. Run around in massive hordes, level up, fight other players and monsters in a persistent world.

title: Die in the Dungeon CLASSIC
description: Dice-based roguelike RPG. Place attack, defense, heal and boost dice strategically to survive deeper dungeon floors.

title: Simple RPGs
description: Classic turn-based dungeon crawler RPG made with PICO-8. Choose a hero, learn skills, fight monsters and find the lost amulet.

title: Krunker.io
description: Fast-paced multiplayer FPS. Quick matches, great movement, and pure skill-based gunplay. Perfect for rage and multiplayer sessions.

title: skribbl.io
description: Draw and guess with friends or strangers. Hilarious multiplayer party game that never gets old.

title: INKWAVE
description: Free 4v4 turf-war shooter. Paint the map with ink, swim through your color, and out-turf the enemy team. Fully browser-based.

title: Shell Shockers
description: Egg-themed multiplayer FPS. Run around as an armed egg and shoot other eggs. Surprisingly addictive and rage-inducing.

title: Page Rage
description: Destroy websites with weapons while flying around with a jetpack. Pure chaotic rage satisfaction in your browser.

title: Don't Rage Quit
description: 2D platformer designed to test your patience and make you want to rage quit. Can you keep calm?

title: Agar.io
description: Classic multiplayer cell game. Eat smaller cells, avoid bigger ones, and grow as large as possible in a chaotic arena.

title: Night Shift: Raven’s Hollow
description: Atmospheric first-person horror. Drive a truck through the desert at night while following strange rules. Headphones recommended.

title: The Backrooms: Level 0
description: Get lost in the endless yellow maze of the Backrooms. Something is waiting for you in the fluorescent lights.

title: Quiet us
description: Short atmospheric horror experience about companionship and silence. Playable directly in browser on itch.io.

title: HaxBall
description: Physics-based multiplayer football/soccer. Simple controls, deep skill ceiling, great for raging with friends.

title: Smash Karts
description: Multiplayer kart racing with weapons. Chaotic, fun, and perfect for yelling at the screen with friends.

title: PartyScape: Idle MMORPG
description: Free multiplayer idle MMORPG that runs entirely in your browser. Progress even when offline.

title: Bound Below
description: Give up the ghost in this atmospheric platformer horror experience available on itch.io.

title: Super Troll World
description: Classic-style platformer full of troll level design meant to make you rage. Can you stay calm?

title: PolyTrack
description: High-speed low-poly racing game. Fast tracks, clean controls, and pure racing fun in your browser.

title: Slow Roads
description: Endless peaceful driving. Generate infinite roads and just cruise. Perfect chill car game.

title: Fall Beans
description: Free Fall Guys-style bean racing. Chaotic obstacle courses with other beans — no download needed.

title: Trigger Dungeon
description: Classic rage platformer full of traps and trolls. Get ready to die a lot and rage a little.

title: Time to Panic!
description: Tiny but extremely frustrating platformer with cute pixel art. Designed to make you panic.

title: Exhibit of Sorrows
description: Creepy horror experience with dolls and a not-so-friendly clown. Atmospheric and unsettling.

title: last seen online
description: Horror puzzle game where you look through a stranger’s computer. Extremely atmospheric.

title: Flesh, Blood, & Concrete
description: RPG Maker-style horror exploration of an apartment building. Deep and creepy.

title: Madalin Stunt Cars 2
description: Open-world stunt driving with supercars, ramps and crazy jumps. Classic free browser car game.

title: Ninja Platformer Rage
description: Precise and punishing ninja platformer. Shadow clones, traps, and pure rage-inducing levels.

title: Level Devil
description: The platformer that does not want you to win. Every jump is a trap, every floor is a lie. Pure rage-inducing fun.

title: OvO
description: Fast-paced stickman parkour platformer. Precise jumps, slides and wall kicks. Very similar frustration level to Level Devil.

title: Slow Roads
description: Relaxing endless driving through beautiful procedurally generated landscapes. No goals, just drive.

title: HexGL
description: High-speed futuristic 3D racing game that runs completely in the browser.

title: PolyTrack
description: High-speed low-poly racing game with track editor. Fast and fun car racing.

title: Don't Look Away
description: Five-night browser horror. Keep your flashlight on the real eyes or something bad happens. Headphones recommended.

title: By Night Collection
description: Atmospheric first-person horror games (Night Shift + Backrooms). Best played at night with headphones.
